installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
apt update -y
apt install -y git python3 python3-venv python3-pip
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
git clone https://{{PAT}}@github.com/BlankTheDeer/gba.git --branch dev --single-branch backend_src
cd backend_src/backend
pip install -r requirements.txt
deactivate
echo 'BlankTB Backend installed successfully.'

variables.name: PAT
variables.description: GitHub Personal Access Token with read-only access to the private BlankTheDeer/gba repo.

variables.name: MONGO_URI
variables.description: MongoDB connection URI for BlankTB Portal.

variables.name: JWT_SECRET
variables.description: JWT signing secret for authentication tokens.

variables.name: RECAPTCHA_SECRET
variables.description: Google reCAPTCHA secret key for form validation.

variables.name: MAIL_PORT
variables.description: SMTP mail server port (usually 587 for TLS).

variables.name: MAIL_USER
variables.description: Email username for outbound mail (e.g., noreply@blanktb.net).

variables.name: MAIL_PASS
variables.description: Password or app token for the mail user.

variables.name: DISCORD_ALERT_WEBHOOK
variables.description: Discord webhook URL for instant alert notifications.

variables.name: DISCORD_UPTIME_WEBHOOK
variables.description: Discord webhook URL for weekly uptime summaries.

variables.name: DOMAIN
variables.description: Public domain name for this backend instance.

variables.name: APP_NAME
variables.description: Display name for this backend instance.

variables.name: APP_VERSION
variables.description: Version label for this backend instance.
